title: Vertical Bifacial Solar Panel Performance Results Part 1
summary: A hobbyist compares vertical bifacial solar panels against south-facing angled panels using winter production results. It tests whether the usual mounting approach is actually best.
why: HN points to it as real-world, side-by-side data on vertical versus angled panel orientation.

quote.text: this person did a side by side experiment on their property with both angled and vertical bifacial with some interesting results.
